# Omnigent capture

These files are a real two-turn session captured on July 10, 2026 from an
Omnigent 0.4.0 local server and Claude SDK harness. The session asked one
research sub-agent to calculate `17 * 23` and another to identify Finland's
capital.

The capture contains no customer data or credentials. It is committed so the
Omnigent event-to-ATIF integration runs in standalone CI without a private
backend checkout.
